name: Award Of Stipend To VJNT And SBC Students Studying In ITI
benefit: Maintenance Allowance from Rs.40/- to Rs.100/- per month for 10 months is provided through the concerned I.T.I.
eligibility_rules: Students should belong to V.J.N.T. or S.B.C category. Students should be trainees of approved I.T.I.The parent/Guardian's income should be up to ₹ 65290/- per year. The selection process is completed by the Principal of the concerned ITI.
documents_required: Caste CertificateDomicile CertificateResidence Proof Aadhar cardBank
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline The application should be submitted to the concerned I.T.I. I.T.I. should submit the same to Asstt. Commissioner, Social Welfare concerned for approval.
